ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels accounting for less than 5% of the total surface area, primarily localized to circular scar rings and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-pixel base layer; discrete high-contrast white rings (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; concentrated high-intensity irregular patches located at the far left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 110-115 degrees; notch vertex creates a distinct sharp convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration map; peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels in depth; serrations are most pronounced and jagged on the outer thirds of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing boundary, tapering to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely clustered circular high-contrast ring-shaped marks; high concentration in the lower-central region of the left lobe and the mid-lateral section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of three diagonal, light-grey linear disruptions visible in the lower-inner quadrant of the right lobe, oriented toward the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant white textural scarring and possible calcareous accumulation on the distal tips of both lobes; extensive coverage of circular parasitic attachment scars throughout the ventral surface.
